_why: THE DEBT RATCHET. These markers are honest conventions — TODO(keys) scaffolds around a missing credential, NOT CHECKED refuses to report a skipped check as done. That honesty is why they grow: writing one is virtuous and nothing ever closes one. Each pile now carries a counted budget and a reason. Over budget FAILS the push; under budget ratchets down. The number can only go down. Ships with every pile at 0 and no history: these numbers are per-repo state, so they baseline against your own tree on first run.

todo-keys.reason: A credential the build was scaffolded around, per the scaffold-around-and-continue rule (marker + a SETUP-KEYS.md row). Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.

todo-credits.reason: A step skipped because a credit balance would not cover it. Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.

not-checked.reason: A check that was skipped, reported honestly as skipped rather than as done. Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.

unverified.reason: A claim recorded without evidence behind it. Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.

still-open.reason: A decision or thread left unresolved. Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.

your-call.reason: A decision handed to a human and not yet made. Ships at 0: baseline it against YOUR tree on the first run, so the ratchet counts your debt and not someone else's.
